title: Polynomial bound on packed records
statement: For every finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine $M$, every binary code for its state alphabet, and all $C,e,c,A,d\in\mathbb{N}$, there is a polynomially bounded function $W:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that, for every bit string $x$ and every cursor $i$ at most one more than the last round for $x$, the packed record word for $x$ and $i$ has length at most $W(|x|)$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary code for the machine's state alphabet
The cursor satisfies $i$ at most one more than the last round for $x$
replaced: For every source machine and parameters, there is a polynomially bounded function $W$ such that for every instance $x$ and cursor $i$ at most the last round plus one, the persistent body word at cursor $i$ has length at most $W(|x|)$.
